summary.result: Then, this paper explores Korea’s position on appropriate rule-setting in the institutional design of a bilateral cooperation framework.
summary.background: Under Article 6.2 of the Paris Agreement, parties can engage in cooperative approaches that involve internationally transferred mitigation outcomes (ITMOs) to achieve targets in their nationally determined contributions (NDCs).
